build_Reader_model: build a DPR Reader model using an encoder module and hidden size for extractive QA
run_Reader_forward: run the Reader model forward pass with input ids, attention mask, and token type ids
create_reader_input_batch: create a ReaderBatch from ReaderSample list with configurable passages per question and max length
compute_reader_loss: compute the combined span and switch loss for Reader model training with start and end logits
review_ReaderBatch_namedtuple: review the ReaderBatch namedtuple structure with input ids, start positions, end positions, answers mask, and token type ids
